summary: Frontend-only desktop and mobile smoke/e2e testing completed for the portfolio landing page. Hero content, section navigation, project cards, mailto link, mobile menu, responsive overflow, and browser console health passed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop 1920px and mobile 390px flows tested against the public preview URL. Initial run had only a malformed diagnostic Page.evaluate selector; corrected rerun passed with no console errors.
rca of the issue: No application issues reproduced. The initial automation failure was caused by unescaped quotes in the tester's JavaScript diagnostic selector, not the app.
